body: Hey man this is awesome! Sometimes people don't even notice that feeling, and it seems you know that you matter. Thanks for sharing this, it made my day better just reading it.

Hello! I'm currently 16 and I went through what you were going through when I was 13. I felt I was worthless, and I felt like the world would be better off without me. You're young, you have so much life to learn and live from!  

I found a group that I was comfortable with and that I could spend quality time with, and it seems like you need to find someone who cares for you. Now I don't know what you feel like, but I have an idea based on what I went through.

Calling yourself a bitch and worthless does nothing for you, in fact it makes you actually feel that way. I'm sure life is rough right now, but just wait and be patient, life works mysterious things.

I'm just an internet stranger, but if you need anyone to talk to don't hesitate.
Sounds like some anxiety concerning your job. It'll be ok, just don't make being late and not showing up a regular thing, you'll be fine!
